summary: JBDI Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a Nasdaq delisting notice for non-compliance with the minimum bid price rule and a reverse stock split. The company received a Determination Letter on January 7, 2026, noting its stock closed under $1 for 30 consecutive days through January 6, 2026. It has until July 6, 2026, to regain compliance. To address this, JBDI announced a 1-for-2 reverse stock split, effective June 25, 2026, approved at its May 28, 2026 AGM. The split aims to raise the per-share price to meet Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). If compliance is not achieved, Nasdaq may delist the shares. This is a routine compliance action, not a special situation.
